"""Ledger reconciliation, lease states and the causal application census."""
import base64, struct, sys

sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')

    'low_count':2}
SVCS=[{'id':'adb','kind':'adb'},{'id':'sync','kind':'sync'},{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}]

def campaign(rows,leases=(L1,),queries=(10,),services=SVCS):
    data='\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n'
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':list(leases),
            'services':services,'queries':list(queries),
            'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]}],
            'requests':[],'offers':[],
            'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':9}],
            'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':9}]}

def lease(out,name='L1',at=None):
    snaps=out['snapshots']
    snap=snaps[0] if at is None else [s for s in snaps if s['at']==at][0]
    for entry in snap['leases']:
        if entry['lease']==name: return entry
    raise KeyError(name)

def svc(entry,name):
    for row in entry['services']:
        if row['id']==name: return row
    raise KeyError(name)

def icmp(ident,event,probe,target,responder,result,revision=0,published=9,lease='L1'):
    return f'icmp,{ident},{revision},{published},put,{lease},{event},{probe},{target},{responder},{result},,,'

def app(ident,event,result,service,attempt=0,payload='',target=None,lease='L1',
        revision=0,published=9):
    target=N1+'1' if target is None else target
    return (f'app,{ident},{revision},{published},put,{lease},{event},,{target},,'
            f'{result},{service},{attempt},{payload}')

def delete(ident,revision,published,lease='L1'):
    return f'icmp,{ident},{revision},{published},delete,{lease},,,,,,,,,'

def adb_packet(command,arg0,arg1,body):
    return struct.pack('<6I',command,arg0,arg1,len(body),
                       sum(body)&0xffffffff,command^0xffffffff)+body

fails=[]
def check(label,got,want):
    if got!=want:
        fails.append(label)
        print('FAIL',label,'\n  got ',got,'\n  want',want)

# 1 usable lease with internal and external evidence
rows=[icmp('a',1,'0/i1',N1+'1',N1+'1','echo'),icmp('b',2,'0/i1',N1+'1',N1+'9','echo'),
      icmp('c',3,'0/i2',N1+'2',N1+'2','error')]
out=run(campaign(rows))
e=lease(out)
check('1 rejected',out['rejected'],[])
check('1 state',e['state'],'usable')
check('1 internal',e['internal'],[N1+'1'])
check('1 external',e['external'],[N1+'9'])

check('1 unresolved',e['unresolved'],[N1+'2'])

rows=[icmp('a',1,'0/i1',N1+'1',N1+'1','echo'),icmp('b',2,'0/i2',N1+'2',N1+'1','echo')]

# a delete at a lower revision never beats a higher put
rows=[delete('a',1,5),icmp('a',2,'0/i1',N1+'1',N1+'1','echo',revision=2,published=5)]
